quality.scope_depth: Finite source-only question, 1800/1800-word budget. Good source tracing, owner accounting, alternatives and gates; no build/runtime/adoption claim.
quality.novelty: R702 covers FP32 64K deferred MoE and generic state/callback limits. R965 rejects widening the full operator to 16K. R966 adds current native16 BF16 aliases, 16K MoE over unchanged 8K operators, and current payload/reuse arithmetic.
quality.redundancy: Causal order, callback and residual-bank cautions recur because they constrain this design; not material duplication. No external implementation or XeStrata source used.

anchors: R16/gated_b16 split one T*D*4 FP32 gated reservation; other native16 views borrow FP32 arena ranges.
Layer-1 PLE restores R16 to FP32 m.R, edits then repacks it. Final native16 callbacks also expand each count*D slice into m.R.
m.region is reused by GDN/QSA/PLE/MoE and draft_kv callback scratch; alias=1 also aliases bo/mixed/ple_emb with emb.
Routing uses mixed_bf; shared/expert paths use mixed_h; FP32 scalar gate and injection remain; BF16 Dm is combined by logical top-k slot with shared addition last.
m.T and QSA16 remain capped at 8192; residual spans/callbacks require current chunk-sized spans.
Final FP32 callback rows feed MTP; draft_kv uses m.region. SYCL top-k masks selected IDs, so each token routes at most once per expert.

accepted: W=16384 slot-order live payload 1,155,137,536 B; prepared phase 169,410,560 B; combine phase 1,008,271,360 B.

BF16 Dm W*10*2560*2 = 838,860,800 B, equal to 8K FP32 Dm backing. The stated 53,248,000 B region growth leaves 39,778,816 B within the 1,180,698,624 B GDN region, under the proposed aliases/per-8K route and phase reuse.

39,261 rows produce 8K,8K,8K,8K,6493 operator chunks; 16K,16K,6493 MoE windows; BF16 residual 804,065,280 B. At 262144: 16 MoE windows and 32 causal chunks. Owner totals are accounting only, not fit proof.
corrections: `cnt[e] >= T` is a pre-increment check: it permits final count exactly T and rejects another assignment. Launch `ne > T` also permits equality. Set the window bound to W in both checks and retain `ne==W`.

Current gather addresses `src_dev+o0`; a window-wide expert offset can exceed the 81920-int current buffer. Rebase/refill each expert's list at `src_dev[0]` (sufficient for ne<=16384), or grow to W*K.

Current R16/gated_b16 and FP32 m.R are only T_op-sized. Keep T_op=8192; never store a live 16K half in m.R or the old gated reservation. Define disjoint row-bank in-place phases. After full-window combine, write and retire one 8K callback slice before reusing 8K output scratch, or preserve both output slices elsewhere; first final callback expands into m.R.

The proposal must finish both 8K GDN/QSA/PLE operator phases before reusing m.region for W MoE. Before callbacks/MTP reuse m.region, MoE owners there must be dead; preserve both output halves outside m.R/region. The report implies but does not fully map this callback-time lifetime.

decision.source_feasibility: Supported: two ordered causal 8K pieces followed by a 16K MoE window has no same-layer attention-to-FFN dependency and can retain slot-order combine.
decision.main_plan_needed: Specify row-bank placement/lifetime, per-slice R16/write/callback order, src_dev rebasing, PLE/emb and MTP/region alias deaths, and cancellation/fault invalidation before patching.
decision.controls: native16 BF16; compactMoE/MMQ=0; alias=1/no prefill borrow; vLLM GEMM auto (ne<128 compact16x64, else wide128x128); T_op=8192.
runtime_gates: When the foreign CPU benchmark is no longer active, Main runs the exact per-window ne/union and route conservation census, logging backend choice, host grouping and dequant/GEMM work.
Same binary, repeated paired 8K/16K whole-request timing; separate GPU completion from host submission/grouping/wait. No speed claim from this source review.
Verify ne=W, route maps, two ordered 8K callbacks, request tail/nonzero pos0, QSA/GDN/PLE state, MTP/final callback, cancellation/fault/RESTORE, and full physical 262144 coverage.

Measure real peak allocations/high-water, faults and transfers with complete model/session/cache/QSA/GDN/prefix/runtime owners and GPU/RAM headroom. Slot-order numerical comparisons include routes, BF16 expert outputs, combine and boundary values across actual backend shapes; accumulator order additionally needs logit/NLL/task-quality gates.
